name: Rollout Coordinator
summary: Assembles a shareable rollout status report from distributed browser, edge, and cloud source fragments.
description: Drives the report.* chain (collect-fragments, enrich-insights, summarize or summarize-semantic, optional translate-fr, format) to turn raw distributed source fragments into one deterministic, optionally French-translated status report. Needs the whole raw-fragments-to-formatted-report path to be deterministic and model-free (or, for summarize-semantic, backed only by a pinned static embedding), without any capability inferring intent from names or natural language.

distinguished_from.how: Assembles a full multi-section report from raw distributed fragments through several capabilities, rather than consuming one already-aggregated bounded-period summary record.
Produces a formatted narrative report from source fragments, rather than consuming a single deterministic completeness signal derived from duration and source-health facts.
